posts.title: Japanese Classes, Semester 3
posts.description: 先月、日本語のクラスがまた始まった。 今 学期 がっき ＣＣＳＦの日本語１６と日本語２Aに入った。 また勉強するが楽しみ！😄 Last month, Japanese classes started again. This semester, I enrolled in Japanese 16 and Japanese 2A at CCSF. I’m looking forward to studying again!

posts.title: Returning to owning things in a streaming world
posts.description: Sophie wrote about rebuilding her music collection with media she owns. It was around 2013 that I started using Spotify, so my digital music collection has been frozen in time ever since, on an external hard drive languishing in the back of a cupboard. posts.title: Notes on Week 27 of 2026
posts.description: It has been several weeks since I posted one of these. Life has been busy! Last weekend was Pride weekend, and I did all the things. Tess and I took Erin to the Trans March on Friday afternoon. Then, we stopped by the Dyke March on Saturday. On Sunday, I took Erin to the Pride Parade. It was a very busy weekend, but we had a great time at all the events. 🏳️ 🌈
